svg.text: Zero-disruption migration from Pattern 005 → Pattern 006. Old and new stacks coexist. Rollback possible through Phase 3.
PARALLEL RUNNING WINDOW — Old & New stacks coexist
✓ Rollback safely possible through end of Phase 3 / Week 10. After that, deprecation begins.
Zero disruption. Sign-off required at every phase boundary.
Old and new stacks coexist throughout the migration window. Vladimir's preference — "I want to take it a little bit slower" — is built into the timeline.
PCI-DSS workloads remain on Pattern 005 (documented exception) • TCM not in scope (departed Finastra) • End-to-end timeline: ~18 weeks (~4.5 months)
